items.title: Document the merge-time combination-review rule for parallel process-framework stories
items.context: Add an advisory process rule to CLAUDE.md (and/or docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md) stating: when multiple process-framework stories (touching classifier / gate policy / command entry guards / auto-commit / DONE merge semantics) are merged to main in parallel, a read-only combination review must be run over the combined main state — checking classification priority order, gate policy, command entry rejection, auto-commit/dirty state, and DONE merge semantics for cross-story conflicts. Derived from the B-8db9 incident where B-cf60 + B-4b22 each passed single-story review but combined into a CRITICAL gate bypass. Rule applies only to process-framework stories, not ordinary business stories.
items.userSees: A reader opening docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md finds a new section (canonical, detailed) titled 「合并态组合审查（流程框架并行 story）」 with: the trigger scope (classifier / gate policy / command entry guards / auto-commit / DONE merge semantics), an enumerated inspection checklist (classification priority order, gate policy table, command entry rejection, auto-commit/dirty state, DONE merge semantics), the B-8db9 originating incident citation, and an explicit "ordinary business stories are out of scope" sentence. CLAUDE.md carries a short summary of the same rule near the 对抗审查 / REVIEW area with a see-also pointer to story-lifecycle.md as canonical.

The rule names a concrete enumerated checklist, not a vague directive sentence — a combination review cannot degrade to a rubber-stamp (preMortem #3 anchor)
